Multiple Accidents Across India Kill Over 40, Injure Hundreds

Recent accidents in several Indian states have caused dozens of deaths and dozens of injuries: a bus plunged about 100 metres into a gorge in Tehri Garhwal, Uttarakhand, killing eight to nine people and injuring 25‑26, with a survivor alleging the driver was speeding; a bus collided with a truck in Assam, killing at least 24 people, many of them college students; a car‑pickup collision near Fazilka in Punjab left five dead and 11 injured; and a residential building collapse in Shahdara, east Delhi, killed two people, including a young child, and injured six.
